trickyParts: The push that carries this handoff deliberately has no `skip-checks: true` line, although it touches only `.legion/INFRA-879/`. The trailer is what left the code with no CI: GitHub honours it for the whole push, and the two code commits rode under it. A head without it is the only way to get a run onto a branch whose code is already pushed, short of rewriting a pushed commit, and the architect asked for exactly this.
The daemon classifies a push by the paths its commits touch rather than by the trailer, so this push is still a handoff push to the daemon; the trailer's only reader is GitHub.
deviations: One line of `skill://legion-worker`'s push rule is not followed, on the architect's instruction: a push that touches only `.legion/<issue>/` normally ends its head with `skip-checks: true`, and this one does not.
